column1: With Block Instant Games ads on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched. No ad plays and the game still gives its reward.
column2: 隨著Block Instant Games的廣告上映,遊戲的獎勵廣告就算上觀看的了,沒有廣告劇本,遊戲仍然給予獎勵.

column1: With Download feed and Watch videos on, coming back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied offers to download it, once per link. Off, Facebook doesn't look at what you copied.
column2: 下載影片和觀看影片, 帶膠捲或影片連結回到Facebook, 複製了每條連結的下載提議。 關閉時, Facebook不會看到你複製的內容 。

column1: With Keep the progress bar on, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above the bar. Off, they show only while you drag it.
column2: 保持進度,一盤膠捲已經過去,總時間停留在酒吧上方。關閉後,它們只會在拖動時顯示。

column1: With Lock Facebook on, it will lock as soon as you leave it.
column2: 鎖上臉書,一離開就會鎖上

column1: With Lock Facebook on, it will lock once you've been away for %1$s.
column2: 鎖上臉書,一旦你離開就會鎖上%1$s。 。 。 。

column1: With Pinch to zoom on, double tap a photo on a profile to zoom in where you tapped, and double tap again to put it back. A single tap still opens the photo, a moment later.
column2: 啟用「雙指縮放」後，雙擊個人檔案上的相片可放大點按位置，再次雙擊可還原。單次點按仍會開啟相片，但稍有延遲。

column1: With Pinch to zoom on, the photo or story stays zoomed when you let go, and a story stays paused. Drag with one finger or pinch again. Tap or press Back when you're done.
column2: 啟用「雙指縮放」後，放開時相片或限時動態會維持縮放，限時動態也會保持暫停。可用單指拖曳或再次雙指縮放。完成後點按或按返回鍵。

column1: With Save any photo on, a post with photos gets Save photo in its three-dot menu too. A post with several saves each one, one after another.
column2: 儲存任何照片後, 帶有照片的帖子也會在其三點選單中儲存照片。 一張有多個儲存的帖子會逐一儲存 。

column1: With Save videos other apps can open on, a full size video Facebook only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Slower, and videos over 10 minutes stay smaller.
column2: 啟用「儲存其他應用程式可開啟的影片」後，若 Facebook 僅提供 VP9 或 AV1 的完整尺寸影片，會在手機上轉換為 H.264，而非儲存較小尺寸。處理較慢，超過 10 分鐘的影片仍使用較小尺寸。

column1: With Stop Story auto-advance on, a finished story plays again from the start instead of waiting on its last frame. Tap or swipe to move on.
column2: 隨著Stop Story自動預告的展開,一個完成的故事從頭開始就再次播放,而不是等待最後的幀. tap 或 swipe 繼續前進.

column1: With a reel or video paused, tap its right side to step one frame forward and its left side to step one frame back. Tap the middle to play.
column2: 暫停 Reels 或影片後，點擊右側可前進一格，點擊左側可倒退一格，點擊中央可繼續播放。

column1: With the switch above on, after you play one reel, the reels you swipe to play on their own. The feed, Watch and stories always wait.
column2: 開啟上面的開關,玩完一盤後,你就可以自己玩的一盤。種子、觀察和故事總是等待。

column1: With the switch above on, only a hold on the right third of a reel plays it at double speed. Hold anywhere else and Facebook's long-press menu opens.
column2: 上面開關後, 只能按下膠捲的右三分之一, 以雙倍的速度播放。請在其它地方按住, Facebook 的長壓選單會開啟 。

column1: With the switch above on, your place stays however long you're away. Pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts.
column2: 開啟上方開關後，無論離開多久都會保留你的位置。下拉重新整理與全新啟動仍會載入新貼文。
